recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. Do not reintroduce DiagnosticRequest.specimen or ServiceRequest.specimen for this old ballot issue; any future request-side specimen-selection change should be handled as a new ServiceRequest/specimenSuggestion issue with OO review.
issue_request: FHIR-11131 asked that Specimen not be removed from DiagnosticRequest and reused the FHIR-10589 OO disposition to support both workflow directions: a request may identify an already-known specimen, and a later collected specimen may reference the request.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 2cd605d912cb03536541fa1b4db1093df394b58b, tagged [#10589], added DiagnosticRequest.specimen as 0..* Reference(Specimen), updated an example with a contained serum specimen, and rewrote DiagnosticRequest notes to explain the request-to-specimen and specimen-to-request workflows.
additional_context: DiagnosticRequest is retired from the current build. FHIR-11119 merged DiagnosticRequest into ProcedureRequest, FHIR-13867 renamed the successor to ServiceRequest, and later OO decisions FHIR-34206, FHIR-48286, FHIR-50611, FHIR-55444, and FHIR-54625 deprecated, replaced, clarified, removed, and confirmed the removal of ServiceRequest.specimen in favor of Specimen.request plus the servicerequest-specimenSuggestion extension.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhir.ini scopes ServiceRequest and Specimen as active resources while DiagnosticRequest is retired; ServiceRequest notes point normal linkage to Specimen.request and request-side specimen selection to the Extension Pack specimenSuggestion extension, and Specimen.request targets ServiceRequest.
